meta.title: Hide and restore the navigation panel

args.goal: On the Home Page, click the left-pointing double arrow next to the grey Procol logo at the bottom left, verify the navigation panel is collapsed, click the restore control, and verify the navigation panel is visible again

steps.note: Performs and observes both the collapse and restore behavior in the buyer session.
Confirms the restored Home Page branding is visible after the panel is shown again.
